note: Both sets mix sound section callouts (W10X15, W8X10, C3X6, L4X4X5/16, HSS 4x4x1/4 with keynote 05) with loose dimension grabs, but Set A also captures genuinely supported items Set B misses, notably the 1 1/2" = 1'-0" detail scale and the PL 4 1/2X4 1/2X1/2 plate size. Set B invents properties and conditions not in the source — 'spacing' for 11 1/2" and 6", 'depth' of a C3X6 for 10", a 'bottom' clearance for 5/8" — and repeats 11 1/2" three times and 1/4" TYP three times. Set A's main faults are vague entities ('structural element', 'dimension'), the misbound PL5X3/8 to 'component B', and a garbled '1" in' clearance, but it introduces fewer fabricated conditions overall.
